title: Dawn Warrior — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1100/1110/1111/1112/1114; WZ API for V/HEXA)

skills.name: Soul of the Guardian
skills.description: Call forth the ancients to defend yourself.

skills.name: Inner Voice
skills.description: Strengthens the soul and empowers the body.

skills.name: Soul Element
skills.description: Summons a light elemental that grants you its power.

skills.name: Falling Moon
skills.description:
Allows you to use Luna skills by receiving the power of the moonlight in the sword. Does not apply to summoning skills, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills. SP is not required for this skill, and it follows the skill level of Rising Sun.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Rising Sun
skills.description:
Allows you to use Solar skills by putting the power of sunlight in the sword.
Can be toggled On/Off.
Rising Sun/Falling Moon Character Stance Lock: Right-click.

skills.name: Soul Leap
skills.description:
Allows you to double jump. Press the up key at the same to move upward.
SP is not required for this skill, and it can be used upon job advancing to Dawn Warrior.

skills.name: Luna Divide
skills.description:
[Luna]
Attack multiple enemies in front by throwing sharp fragments that were broken off from the moon.

skills.name: Solar Slash
skills.description:
[Solar]
Attack multiple enemies in front with swordsmanship that could cleave the sun.

skills.name: Divine Hand
skills.description: Perform an accurate strike with your unshakable faith.

skills.name: Soul Speed
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Sword Mastery
skills.description: Increases One-Handed and Two-Handed Sword Mastery.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Celestial Vision
skills.description: Enhance your swordsmanship with celestial energy.

skills.name: Equinox Cycle
skills.description:
Reconfigures the solar and lunar cycles to automatically change stances when using Solar/Luna skills. Additionally enhances the effect of Rising Sun and Falling Moon.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Soul Blessing
skills.description: Enhances your Attack Power with a burning passion.

skills.name: Luna Divide
skills.description:
[Luna]
Attacks multiple enemies in front by throwing sharp fragments that were broken off from the moon.

skills.name: Solar Slash
skills.description:
[Solar]
Attacks multiple enemies in front with swordsmanship that could cleave the sun.

skills.name: Cosmic Matter
skills.description: Launches a condensed dark matter in front. If the dark matter attacks all attackable targets or reaches max range, it explodes to deal damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Will of Steel
skills.description: It takes a strong mind to push through hardships.

skills.name: Inner Shout
skills.description: Focus your mind to reinvigorate your body.

skills.name: Celestial Vision II
skills.description: Enhances Solar Slash and Luna Divide by practicing the celestial swordsmanship even further.

skills.name: Soul Blessing II
skills.description: Enhances Attack Power by further honing the power of the soul.

skills.name: Equinox Mastery
skills.description: Enhances the effects of Rising Sun and Falling Moon by training the sun and moon swordsmanship. Overwrites the effects of Rising Sun and Falling Moon.

skills.name: Luna Divide
skills.description:
[Luna]
Attacks multiple enemies in front by throwing sharp fragments that were broken off from the moon.

skills.name: Solar Slash
skills.description:
[Solar]
Attacks multiple enemies in front with swordsmanship that could cleave the sun.

skills.name: True Sight
skills.description: See through the veil of the physical world to pierce your target's soul.

skills.name: Cosmic Shower
skills.description:
Uses the dormant power in the orbs to create a meteor shower zone that continuously attacks the surroundings for a set time.
Cosmic Shower can be used without casting motion during Solar Slash, Luna Divide, and Styx Crossing. The duration of Cosmic Shower doesn't increase with the summons duration increase, and is unaffected by attack reflection. The attack count increase effect of Falling Moon doesn't apply.

skills.name: Flicker
skills.description:
[Luna]
Instantly knocks back enemies and cuts them. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Bluster
skills.description:
[Solar]
Knocks back enemies with a forward dash. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Soul Pledge
skills.description: Form a contract with the ancients to become an unwavering warrior.

skills.name: Student of the Blade
skills.description: Increases One-Handed and Two-Handed Sword Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Unpredictable
skills.description: Attack with an unpredictable strike, negating enemy defenses.

skills.name: Master of the Sword
skills.description: You become a master of the sword, mastering both types of powers. Additionally enhances the effect of Rising Sun and Falling Moon, and the effect of Rising Sun and Falling Moon activates at the same time during Equinox Cycle. Overwrites the effect of Rising Sun and Falling Moon.

skills.name: Celestial Vision III
skills.description: Enhances Solar Slash and Luna Divide by commanding the perfect celestial swordsmanship.

skills.name: Soul Blessing III
skills.description: Enhances your inner self by raising the power of the soul to the extreme. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: True Sight - Persist
skills.description: Increases True Sight's duration.

skills.name: True Sight - Enhance
skills.description: Enhances True Sight. Increases final damage on enemies with True Sight applied.

skills.name: True Sight - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases True Sight's Defense Reduction.

skills.name: Cosmic Shower/Burst - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Cosmic Shower and Cosmic Burst.

skills.name: Cosmic Burst - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Cosmic Burst.

skills.name: Cosmic Shower - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Cosmic Shower.

skills.name: Divide and Slash - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Solar Slash and Luna Divide.

skills.name: Divide and Slash - Spread
skills.description: Increases Max Enemies Hit for Solar Slash and Luna Divide.

skills.name: Divide and Slash - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Solar Slash and Luna Divide.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Impaling Rays
skills.description: Summons swords from the sky to impale your enemies. Affects bosses.

skills.name: Impaling Rays
skills.description: Summons swords from the sky to impale your enemies. Affects bosses.

skills.name: Equinox Slash
skills.description: Charge forward and slash the enemy. Can be used while using your skills.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Cosmic Burst
skills.description:
Releases cosmic orbs to attack. Cosmic Burst can be used without casting motion during Solar Slash, Luna Divide, and Styx Crossing. The released cosmic orbs target the boss with the highest HP first, and is unaffected by attack reflection. Cosmic Burst is not affected by effects which reset or reduce cooldown.
In Auto Mode, Cosmic Burst is used automatically when it's not on cooldown, upon landing Solar Slash, Luna Divide, or Styx Crossing.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Glory of the Guardians
skills.description: A ceremony for Cygnus Knights to pledge their devotion to the Empress.

skills.name: Cosmic Forge
skills.description: Sharpens the blade with celestial energy to temporarily maximize combat ability.

skills.name: Luster Charge
skills.description:
[Luna]
Move while instantly cutting enemies with the sword imbued with the cold moon essence. Become temporarily invincible upon use. Shares a cooldown with Blazing Assault, and can be used by linking with Blazing Assault once within a set time after casting. If you linked from Blazing Assault, you cannot link to Blazing Assault.

skills.name: Blazing Assault
skills.description:
[Solar]
Move while instantly cutting enemies with the sword enveloped in the sun's flame. Become temporarily invincible upon use. Shares a cooldown with Luster Charge, and can be used by linking with Luster Charge once regardless of the stance within a set time after casting. If you linked from Luster Charge, you cannot link to Luster Charge. Stance does not change due to Equinox Cycle.

skills.name: Flare Slash
skills.description: Unleash an explosive eruption of forged Spiritual Resin. Activates when your attack skill hits while in Falling Moon or Rising Sun stances. Cooldown is reduced when stance is changed with Equinox Cycle or Styx Crossing hits. Flare Slash is unaffected by attack reflection and cooldown reduction.

skills.name: Rift of Damnation
skills.description:
Creates a rift between the world of the living and the Underworld when used with Styx Crossing. You can use Styx Crossing with a regular attack while Rift of Damnation is active. Using Action Customization allows you to use Styx Crossing with a regular attack or Solar Slash/Luna Divide. Styx Crossing and the attack from the rift is unaffected by attack reflection.
Action Customization On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Soul Eclipse
skills.description: Focus your wisdom and the strength of your soul to call forth a stunning eclipse. When the sun and the moon completely overlap, use the skill one more time to use Equinox Divide. Equinox Divide can be used while attacking with Solar Slash, Luna Divide, and Styx Crossing. The eclipse is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Equinox Divide
skills.description: Cuts through the sun and the moon with the power of soul.

skills.name: Cosmos
skills.description: Unleash a swirl of a complete galaxy around you. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Cosmic Shower
skills.description:
Uses the dormant power in the orbs to create a meteor shower zone that continuously attacks the surroundings for a set time.
Cosmic Shower can be used without casting motion during Solar Slash, Luna Divide, and Styx Crossing.
The duration of Cosmic Shower doesn't increase with the summons duration increase, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
The attack count increase effect of Falling Moon doesn't apply.

skills.name: Equinox Power
skills.description:
Detonate the power that lies within the merged celestial body, 
consecutively activating the sword energy of blinding sun rays and the cold moonlight.
Activates automatically if Equinox Power is not on cooldown when landing Solar Slash,
Luna Divide, or Styx Crossing.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Cosmic Burst
skills.description:
Releases cosmic orbs to attack. Cosmic Burst can be used without casting motion during Solar Slash, Luna Divide, and Styx Crossing. The released cosmic orbs target the boss with the highest HP first, and is unaffected by attack reflection. Cosmic Burst is not affected by effects which reset or reduce cooldown.
In Auto Mode, Cosmic Burst is used automatically when it's not on cooldown, upon landing Solar Slash, Luna Divide, or Styx Crossing.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: HEXA Equinox Slash
skills.description:
Charge forward and slash the enemy. Can be used while using your other skills.
Also permanently increases damage of HEXA Cosmic Shower and HEXA Cosmic Burst.

skills.name: Equinox Power II
skills.description:
Fully awakens the merged celestial body to loose a grand attack. After activating the sword energy of blinding sun rays and the cold moonlight, the sun rays and moonlight join to attack the enemy.
Activates automatically if Equinox Power is not on cooldown when landing Solar Slash, Luna Divide, or Styx Crossing.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Luna Divide
skills.description:
[Luna]
Use the moon to slice through enemies in front.

skills.name: HEXA Solar Slash
skills.description:
[Solar]
Attack enemies in front with the power of the sun.

skills.name: Astral Blitz
skills.description:
A sword forged from your own soul cuts the formless space to reproduce the Big Bang.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Astral Blitz
skills.description: A sword forged from your own soul cuts the formless space and increases final damage.

skills.name: Totality
skills.description:
Harmonizes your soul with the power of the cosmos. Using the skill again while the soul aura is active will demolish your enemies with the explosive power of cosmic creation.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
